questions.question: In which year did Europa Clipper leave Earth on its journey to Jupiter?
questions.evidence: NASA records the launch date as October 14, 2024.
choice_notes: 2014 is ten years before the launch.

questions.question: NASA reported Dragonfly’s first simulated flight on October 23, 2026. Where did the test take place?
questions.explanation: The test used flight-like avionics on a computer testbed at Johns Hopkins APL in Maryland.
questions.evidence: NASA describes a computer testbed at Johns Hopkins APL, rather than a flight on Titan.
choice_notes: NASA identifies a computer testbed in Maryland.
Titan was the simulated setting, not the actual test location.
The test was in a terrestrial laboratory, not Saturn orbit.
Dragonfly’s test was not conducted on the Moon.

questions.question: Which Europa Clipper system also supports its gravity experiment?
questions.explanation: NASA describes a gravity experiment that uses the spacecraft’s telecommunications system.
questions.evidence: NASA lists nine science instruments plus a gravity experiment using the telecommunications system.
choice_notes: NASA names telecommunications as the gravity-experiment system.
Europa Clipper is an orbiter/flyby mission, with no landing legs.
This mission does not carry a sample-return capsule.
It conducts flybys and has no surface drilling rig.
